# Release gate checklist template

## Claim under review
- surface key
- workflow
- browser lane
- requested tier change

## Checklist
- real official surface demonstrated
- action visible and operator-traceable
- structured state emitted
- action outcome emitted where relevant
- named evidence refs preserved
- current drift status known
- caveats documented
- support record updated

## Recommendation
- promote
- hold
- demote

## Reasoning summary
- concise explanation tied to evidence refs
